name: Herschel Walker
desc: American diplomat and former football player (born 1962)

offices.t: United States Ambassador to the Bahamas

summary: Herschel Junior Walker (born March 3, 1962) is an American diplomat and former professional football running back who has served as United States ambassador to the Bahamas since 2025. A member of the Republican Party, he previously played in the National Football League (NFL) for 12 seasons. He was also the Republican nominee in the 2022 U.S. Senate election in Georgia.
